about: SYNTHETIC demo data. Rider ratings, comments, routes and the driver are simulated. Only the video is real (Toronto dashcam drives, camera_id pie_cam-3). The UI and README must say so. Fill original_video from /videos/explore on the VM, then assign each trip a story_role AFTER analysis, based on what the video really shows.

unfair_low_rating.assign_to: The trip whose strongest moment is handled_well (ideally pedestrian_yield) and that has no coachable moment of severity 2 or 3.
unfair_low_rating.rider_comment: Driver braked hard out of nowhere. Did not feel safe.

missed_risk.assign_to: The trip with the clearest coachable moment of severity 2 or 3.

mixed.assign_to: A trip with both a handled_well and a coachable moment.
mixed.rider_comment: Fine overall. Drop-off was a bit rushed.

clean.assign_to: A trip with no coachable moments.

live_demo.assign_to: One short trip left OUT of moments.json so it can be analysed live in the demo.
